files.afterContent: Courier Relay protocol-1 delivery identity contract, binding for both count and summary commands when a request explicitly names "protocol":"1"; protocol 1 remains supported after protocol 2 became current. Source of approval: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract), applied to summary by issue trial-vo0 (2026-09-07); protocol 1 was the current protocol (selected by omitted protocol) until issue trial-9vn adopted protocol 2 as current on 2026-09-08 (see courier-relay/protocol-2-identity-contract). Contract: the pair (account_id, delivery_id) identifies a delivery; the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: earliest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for the identity are duplicates. Response objects contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count; empty batch returns 0/0. Implementation: main.py protocol_counts(q) serves both commands; a future protocol version must update both commands together, not just the current one. Verified by public_tests/count_1.json, public_tests/summary_1.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py (explicit protocol-1 cases passing, 30 tests total) on 2026-09-08.
